## Trimming Outgroup for RBM1
```{r}
# === Load library ===
library(Biostrings)

# === Input parameters ===
input_fasta <- "Data/15_FinalAnlaysis_SpoRemoved_WithOutgroup_D1_D2_D2/YEBC_Outgroup_3di.fasta"          # path to your fasta file
output_fasta <- "Data/15_FinalAnlaysis_SpoRemoved_WithOutgroup_D1_D2_D2/YEBC_Outgroup_RBM1.fasta" # name for trimmed output
seq_name <- "YEBC_TranscriptionalRegulator"         # exact sequence name (must match FASTA header)
start_pos <- 132                    # start trimming position
end_pos <- 194                         # end trimming position

# === Read sequences ===
seqs <- readAAStringSet(input_fasta)

# === Check if sequence exists ===
if (!(seq_name %in% names(seqs))) {
  stop(paste("Sequence", seq_name, "not found in FASTA file."))
}

# === Extract and trim ===
selected_seq <- seqs[[seq_name]]
trimmed_seq <- subseq(selected_seq, start = start_pos, end = end_pos)

# === Save trimmed sequence ===
trimmed_set <- AAStringSet(trimmed_seq)
names(trimmed_set) <- paste0(seq_name)
writeXStringSet(trimmed_set, filepath = output_fasta)

cat("Trimmed sequence saved to:", output_fasta, "\n")

```


```{r}
library(Biostrings)

# === Input parameters ===
input_fasta  <- "Data/15_FinalAnlaysis_SpoRemoved_WithOutgroup_D1_D2_D2/YEBC_Outgroup_3di.fasta"
output_fasta <- "Data/15_FinalAnlaysis_SpoRemoved_WithOutgroup_D1_D2_D2/YEBC_Outgroup_RBM2.fasta"
output_fasta_2 <- "Data/15_FinalAnlaysis_SpoRemoved_WithOutgroup_D1_D2_D2/YEBC_Outgroup_RBM3.fasta"

seq_name <- "YEBC_TranscriptionalRegulator"

# Two regions to extract:
start_pos1 <- 3
end_pos1   <- 32

start_pos2 <- 86
end_pos2   <- 128

# === Read sequences ===
seqs <- readAAStringSet(input_fasta)

# === Check if sequence exists ===
if (!(seq_name %in% names(seqs))) {
  stop(paste("Sequence", seq_name, "not found in FASTA file."))
}

# === Extract sequence ===
selected_seq <- seqs[[seq_name]]

# === Trim two regions ===
trim1 <- subseq(selected_seq, start = start_pos1, end = end_pos1)
trim2 <- subseq(selected_seq, start = start_pos2, end = end_pos2)

# === Concatenate ===
concat_seq <- c(trim1, trim2)
concat_seq <- do.call(xscat, as.list(concat_seq))  # Biostrings-safe concatenation

# === Make AAStringSet for output ===
trimmed_set <- AAStringSet(concat_seq)
names(trimmed_set) <- paste0(seq_name)

# === Save ===
writeXStringSet(trimmed_set, filepath = output_fasta)
writeXStringSet(trimmed_set, filepath = output_fasta_2)
```

### Concating Domain3 Horizontally

## Split FLiF and create separate files
```{r}
library(Biostrings)

# Load aligned FASTA
fasta_file <- "Data/15_FinalAnlaysis_SpoRemoved_WithOutgroup_D1_D2_D2/3di_famsa3diAligned_unsplit.fasta"
seqs <- readAAStringSet(fasta_file)

# Identify sequences ending with "_FliF"
fliF_idx <- grep("_FliF$", names(seqs))

# Prepare containers
split_rbm1 <- AAStringSet()
split_rbm2 <- AAStringSet()
split_rbm3 <- AAStringSet()

# Loop through each FliF sequence
for (i in fliF_idx) {
  seq <- seqs[[i]]
  name_base <- names(seqs)[i]
  
  # Extract RBM1, RBM2, RBM3
  rbm1 <- subseq(seq, start = 218, end = 404)
  rbm2 <- subseq(seq, start = 418, end = 778)
  rbm3 <- subseq(seq, start = 845, end = 1394)
  
  # Add each RBM to its respective container (same names)
  rbm1_entry <- AAStringSet(rbm1)
  names(rbm1_entry) <- name_base
  split_rbm1 <- c(split_rbm1, rbm1_entry)
  
  rbm2_entry <- AAStringSet(rbm2)
  names(rbm2_entry) <- name_base
  split_rbm2 <- c(split_rbm2, rbm2_entry)
  
  rbm3_entry <- AAStringSet(rbm3)
  names(rbm3_entry) <- name_base
  split_rbm3 <- c(split_rbm3, rbm3_entry)
}

# Remove gaps from sequences
split_rbm1 <- AAStringSet(gsub("-", "", as.character(split_rbm1)))
split_rbm2 <- AAStringSet(gsub("-", "", as.character(split_rbm2)))
split_rbm3 <- AAStringSet(gsub("-", "", as.character(split_rbm3)))

# Write to separate FASTA files
writeXStringSet(split_rbm1, "Data/15_FinalAnlaysis_SpoRemoved_WithOutgroup_D1_D2_D2/3di_FliF_RBM1.fasta")
writeXStringSet(split_rbm2, "Data/15_FinalAnlaysis_SpoRemoved_WithOutgroup_D1_D2_D2/3di_FliF_RBM2.fasta")
writeXStringSet(split_rbm3, "Data/15_FinalAnlaysis_SpoRemoved_WithOutgroup_D1_D2_D2/3di_FliF_RBM3.fasta")

```

## Saving Separate SPO files
```{r}
fasta_file <- "Data/15_FinalAnlaysis_SpoRemoved_WithOutgroup_D1_D2_D2/3di_famsa3diAligned_unsplit.fasta"
seqs <- readAAStringSet(fasta_file)

# === Identify sequences by suffix ===
seqs_H <- seqs[grep("SpoIIIAH$", names(seqs))]
seqs_G <- seqs[grep("SpoIIIAG$", names(seqs))]
seqs_F <- seqs[grep("SpoIIIAF$", names(seqs))]

# === Remove gaps (optional but useful) ===
seqs_H <- AAStringSet(gsub("-", "", as.character(seqs_H)))
seqs_G <- AAStringSet(gsub("-", "", as.character(seqs_G)))
seqs_F <- AAStringSet(gsub("-", "", as.character(seqs_F)))

# === Write to separate files ===
writeXStringSet(seqs_H, "Data/15_FinalAnlaysis_SpoRemoved_WithOutgroup_D1_D2_D2/3di_SpoIIIAH_RBM2_Unmatched.fasta")
writeXStringSet(seqs_G, "Data/15_FinalAnlaysis_SpoRemoved_WithOutgroup_D1_D2_D2/3di_SpoIIIAG_RBM3_Unmatched.fasta")
writeXStringSet(seqs_F, "Data/15_FinalAnlaysis_SpoRemoved_WithOutgroup_D1_D2_D2/3di_SpoIIIAF_RBM2.fasta")
```

## Renaminng Spo AG And AH sequences
```{r}
xlsfn = "Data/15_FinalAnlaysis_SpoRemoved_WithOutgroup_D1_D2_D2/SporulationMatchingGenus_SpoIIIAH.xlsx" ## excel file with accession Number and desirable name
xls = openxlsx::read.xlsx(xlsxFile=xlsfn, sheet=1, startRow=1, colNames=TRUE)
fasta_file <- seqinr::read.fasta (file = "Data/15_FinalAnlaysis_SpoRemoved_WithOutgroup_D1_D2_D2/3di_SpoIIIAH_RBM2_Unmatched.fasta") ## Fasta file to be renamed
newnames = as.array(xls$protein)
accession_number = as.array(xls$AccessionNumber)
print(accession_number)
names(fasta_file) <- sapply(names(fasta_file), function(name) {
  fasta_ids <- strsplit(name, split = "\\.")[[1]][1]
  matched_name <- NULL
   for (j in 1:length(newnames)){
    newnames_accession <- strsplit(accession_number[j], split = "\\.")[[1]][1]
    if (fasta_ids == newnames_accession) {
      matched_name <- newnames[j]
      break
   }
   }
  if (!is.null(matched_name)) {
    return(matched_name)
  } else {
    return(name)
  }
})
seqinr::write.fasta(sequences = fasta_file, names=names(fasta_file), file.out = "Data/15_FinalAnlaysis_SpoRemoved_WithOutgroup_D1_D2_D2/3di_SpoIIIAH_RBM2.fasta") 
```

## Split T3SS and create separate files
```{r}
library(Biostrings)

# === Load aligned FASTA ===
fasta_file <- "Data/15_FinalAnlaysis_SpoRemoved_WithOutgroup_D1_D2_D2/3di_famsa3diAligned_unsplit.fasta"
seqs <- readAAStringSet(fasta_file)

# === Identify sequences containing "T3SS" ===
t3ss_idx <- grep("T3SS", names(seqs))

# === Prepare containers for RBM1 and RBM2 ===
split_rbm1 <- AAStringSet()
split_rbm2 <- AAStringSet()

# === Loop through each T3SS sequence ===
for (i in t3ss_idx) {
  seq <- seqs[[i]]
  name_base <- names(seqs)[i]
  
  # Extract RBM1 and RBM2
  rbm1 <- subseq(seq, start = 218, end = 404)
  rbm2 <- subseq(seq, start = 418, end = 778)
  
  # Store with same names
  rbm1_entry <- AAStringSet(rbm1)
  names(rbm1_entry) <- name_base
  split_rbm1 <- c(split_rbm1, rbm1_entry)
  
  rbm2_entry <- AAStringSet(rbm2)
  names(rbm2_entry) <- name_base
  split_rbm2 <- c(split_rbm2, rbm2_entry)
}

# === Remove gaps ===
split_rbm1 <- AAStringSet(gsub("-", "", as.character(split_rbm1)))
split_rbm2 <- AAStringSet(gsub("-", "", as.character(split_rbm2)))

# === Write only RBM1 and RBM2 sequences to files ===
writeXStringSet(split_rbm1, "Data/15_FinalAnlaysis_SpoRemoved_WithOutgroup_D1_D2_D2/3di_T3SS_RBM1.fasta")
writeXStringSet(split_rbm2, "Data/15_FinalAnlaysis_SpoRemoved_WithOutgroup_D1_D2_D2/3di_T3SS_RBM2.fasta")
```

## Concat RBM1, RBM2, RBM3
```{r}
library(Biostrings)

# === Directory containing your FASTA files ===
input_dir <- "Data/15_FinalAnlaysis_SpoRemoved_WithOutgroup_D1_D2_D2"

# === Find all FASTA files by suffix ===
rbm1_files <- list.files(input_dir, pattern = "RBM1\\.fasta$", full.names = TRUE)
rbm2_files <- list.files(input_dir, pattern = "RBM2\\.fasta$", full.names = TRUE)
rbm3_files <- list.files(input_dir, pattern = "RBM3\\.fasta$", full.names = TRUE)

# === Helper function to read and combine FASTAs ===
combine_fastas <- function(file_list) {
  all_seqs <- AAStringSet()
  for (f in file_list) {
    seqs <- readAAStringSet(f)
    all_seqs <- c(all_seqs, seqs)
  }
  return(all_seqs)
}

# === Combine and save ===
if (length(rbm1_files) > 0) {
  combined_rbm1 <- combine_fastas(rbm1_files)
  writeXStringSet(combined_rbm1, file.path(input_dir, "3di_RBM1.fasta"))
}

if (length(rbm2_files) > 0) {
  combined_rbm2 <- combine_fastas(rbm2_files)
  writeXStringSet(combined_rbm2, file.path(input_dir, "3di_RBM2.fasta"))
}

if (length(rbm3_files) > 0) {
  combined_rbm3 <- combine_fastas(rbm3_files)
  writeXStringSet(combined_rbm3, file.path(input_dir, "3di_RBM3.fasta"))
}

```

# Align the 3di sequences, using famsa3di
```{bash}

famsa3di ./Data/15_FinalAnlaysis_SpoRemoved_WithOutgroup_D1_D2_D2/3di_RBM1.fasta ./Data/15_FinalAnlaysis_SpoRemoved_WithOutgroup_D1_D2_D2/3di_RBM1_famsa3dialigned.fasta
famsa3di ./Data/15_FinalAnlaysis_SpoRemoved_WithOutgroup_D1_D2_D2/3di_RBM2.fasta ./Data/15_FinalAnlaysis_SpoRemoved_WithOutgroup_D1_D2_D2/3di_RBM2_famsa3dialigned.fasta
famsa3di ./Data/15_FinalAnlaysis_SpoRemoved_WithOutgroup_D1_D2_D2/3di_RBM3.fasta ./Data/15_FinalAnlaysis_SpoRemoved_WithOutgroup_D1_D2_D2/3di_RBM3_famsa3dialigned.fasta

```

```{r}
library(Biostrings)

# === Input files (edit paths) ===
file1 <- "Data/15_FinalAnlaysis_SpoRemoved_WithOutgroup_D1_D2_D2/3di_RBM1_famsa3dialigned.fasta"
file2 <- "Data/15_FinalAnlaysis_SpoRemoved_WithOutgroup_D1_D2_D2/3di_RBM2_famsa3dialigned.fasta"

# === Read sequences ===
seqs1 <- readAAStringSet(file1)
seqs2 <- readAAStringSet(file2)

# === Convert to named character vectors ===
seqs1_vec <- setNames(as.character(seqs1), names(seqs1))
seqs2_vec <- setNames(as.character(seqs2), names(seqs2))

# === Combine all sequence names ===
all_names <- unique(c(names(seqs1_vec), names(seqs2_vec)))

# === Determine max lengths for padding ===
maxlen1 <- max(nchar(seqs1_vec))
maxlen2 <- max(nchar(seqs2_vec))

# === Initialize result ===
combined_vec <- character(length(all_names))
names(combined_vec) <- all_names

# === Merge horizontally (with gap-fill if missing) ===
for (n in all_names) {
  seq1 <- if (n %in% names(seqs1_vec)) seqs1_vec[[n]] else paste0(rep("-", maxlen1), collapse = "")
  seq2 <- if (n %in% names(seqs2_vec)) seqs2_vec[[n]] else paste0(rep("-", maxlen2), collapse = "")
  
  combined_vec[[n]] <- paste0(seq1, seq2)
}

# === Convert back to AAStringSet ===
combined_set <- AAStringSet(combined_vec)

# === Write output ===
output_file <- "Data/15_FinalAnlaysis_SpoRemoved_WithOutgroup_D1_D2_D2/3di_RBM1_2_famsa3dialigned.fasta"
writeXStringSet(combined_set, output_file)



```

## Removing AH, AG and AF files from the final file trying a separate analysis
```{r}
library(Biostrings)

# === Input and output files ===
input_file <- "Data/15_FinalAnlaysis_SpoRemoved_WithOutgroup_D1_D2_D2/3di_RBM1_2_3_famsa3dialigned.fasta"    # replace with your fasta file path
output_file <- "Data/15_FinalAnlaysis_SpoRemoved_WithOutgroup_D1_D2_D2/3di_RBM1_2_3_famsa3dialigned_Spo_removed.fasta"

# === Read sequences ===
seqs <- readAAStringSet(input_file)

# === Filter sequences ===
# Keep sequences whose names do NOT end with the given patterns
keep_seqs <- seqs[!grepl("(SpoIIIAG|SpoIIIAF|SpoIIIAH)$", names(seqs))]

# === Save filtered sequences ===
writeXStringSet(keep_seqs, output_file)
```

```{bash}
trimal -in ./Data/15_FinalAnlaysis_SpoRemoved_WithOutgroup_D1_D2_D2/3di_RBM1_2_3_famsa3dialigned_Spo_removed.fasta -out ./Data/15_FinalAnlaysis_SpoRemoved_WithOutgroup_D1_D2_D2/3di_RBM1_2_3_famsa3dialigned_Spo_removed_trim35.fasta -gt 0.35 -colnumbering | tee ./Data/15_FinalAnlaysis_SpoRemoved_WithOutgroup_D1_D2_D2/3di_RBM1_2_3_famsa3dialigned_Spo_removed_trim35_cols.txt
```
